description: REQ-I2 spec (behavioral-spec.md:117-123) demands: 'snapshots <slot_dir>/tasks/* + <slot_dir>/build_log.md mtimes BEFORE STEP 6, asserts STEP 6 adds AT MOST one tasks/ file and appends to build_log.md AT MOST one "## " section.' The implementation in test_dispatch_integration_step6.py::test_step6_does_not_write_outside_tasks_and_build_log only snapshots seeded EXTRAS (menu.json, other.txt, subdir/nested.txt) and proves they are unchanged. It does NOT snapshot tasks/* before/after and does NOT assert the 'AT MOST one ## section' append boundary. A regression that double-appends to build_log.md (e.g. accidentally calling append_pass twice) or writes a second sibling file into tasks/ would pass this test. The test is a partial proxy of REQ-I2, not a complete one.
